title: Suspected duplicates
subtitle: Pairs detected automatically, the closest match first. Nothing is merged without a human decision.

empty.title: No suspected duplicate
empty.description: The directory shows no suspicious pair. Detection runs continuously: new pairs will appear here.

settled.title: Already settled
settled.hint: A decision can be revisited: a pair dismissed by mistake is found here.

reasons.label: Grounds for suspicion
reasons.nameSimilarityHint: The names of both records overlap.
reasons.sharedDomainHint: Both records declare {domain}: the most reliable signal.
reasons.sameCountryHint: Two records from the same country. On its own, this proves nothing.
reasons.acronymMatchHint: One record's acronym is the other's name — the first flaw of the old platform.

distinctDialog.title: Remove this pair from the queue
distinctDialog.description: “{left}” and “{right}” will be treated as two distinct organizations and will no longer be suggested.
distinctDialog.notePlaceholder: Two different bodies despite similar names.
distinctDialog.noteHint: Optional, but whoever reads this decision in six months will thank you.

deferSuccess: Pair deferred. It remains available under settled pairs.
